text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hup, hah...! Heave-ho...! Heave-ho...!

I ended up watching Yukino Bijin's dance 
lesson. However, she didn't seem satisfied 
with her performance...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"It's no good-han... My dance lacks flair, 
or rather... is it a bit uncool...?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: How can I give this a more modern vibe?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... First, I should watch and 
learn! If I watch lots of stylish dances 
and absorb them...!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still though, where on earth can you go to 
see something like that...?
choice_data_list: Let's go check out a stylish spot.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A stylish place, huh...! I know! If we're 
talking places where trendy folks dance, 
there's a spot I just saw on 
Umastagram...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
We're here! A "disco"...! So this is where 
the city youth come to dance...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes, exactly! Look, over there, those 
stylish people are...!

text_block_list.name: Woman with Pompadour Bangs
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay~! It's so retro it's stylish~! 
Dancing on a podium at a night pool is 
totally hip~!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Whoo! Whoooo! Let's get fevering today 
too~♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hawawa...! Ain't that Maruzen-san! 
Ev-Everyone's so hyped up, they are...! 
The dancin' is super energetic too...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"A-Am I really out of place here after 
all? I didn't think it'd be this flashy—"
choice_data_list: As long as we're together, we'll be okay.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...! That's right, I've got you with me, 
Trainer! There was nothin' to be scared of 
at all...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's try mimicking the dance! 
Hyaaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Phew! Phew! Stay in rhythm!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Isn't that Yukino-chan! Oh my gosh, 
totally rad! Her dancing is super groovy 
too!

text_block_list.name: Woman with Pompadour Bangs
text_block_list.text:
Whooo! So cuuute! Hey, hey! Come dance 
over here with me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "Wh-wh-what?! M-Me...?! Hawawawa...!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes! I'm gonna dance modern dances 
heaps and bounds, and learn a whole 
bunch!"

Yukino Bijin danced her heart out with the 
groovy youngsters, and seemed to have 
grasped something...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I see, UmaTok! Let's check it out right 
away!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
All right, time to search up some stylish 
dances~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Umm, is the hashtag... this one...? Let's 
see, let's see... like this!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Mrmph... Why are totally different videos 
showing up...? Ummm, how do I sort by 
popularity...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Aya, thank you so much! Trainer, you're 
amazin'. Movin' 'em around so smoothly 
like that...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wah... So many stylish things came out. 
Wait, what is this...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Trot, trot, trot♪ Hop, skip☆ Kyun-kyu~n♪ 
Everyone join in~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wah! It's Curren-san! Whoa, she's so darn 
cuuute~~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
'#Currens10SecDanceLesson' 
'#DanceTogether' ...apparently!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: —Ta-da☆ All done! How does it look~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
*clap clap clap*~! Perfect score! ☆ You 
were super cute~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "Wh-what! Curren-san, you were here?!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I just got here! I heard the sound 
of Curren's video, so I snuck a peek♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for dancing with me♪ Curren is 
super happy~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
No no, thank YOU! Thanks to you, I was 
able to learn such a cute and trendy 
dance!
